long_description.before:
Zaz OS is a “Lovable for internal products”: an AI-native platform with an opinionated infrastructure that makes it easy to build and edit Apps and Agents through vibe-coding. Using spec-driven development, it ensures consistency and security for critical processes, solving challenges like user management, notifications, and multi-app integration within a single interface.

With over eight years of experience in back-office and HR, Zaz OS was designed from the ground up with core structural issues already solved and the flexibility to adapt to each company’s unique needs. The result is the speed to build and iterate, combined with the robustness required for mission-critical processes — the ultimate solution to replace the Frankenstein stack of SaaS tools that currently dominates company management.
As companies grow, the lack of customization of current software forces Heads of HR to buy multiple disconnected tools, allocate engineers to build and maintain people-related projects or use spreadsheets.
long_description.after:
Software is now cheap to build. Every company will have its own custom all-in-one OS. zaz⚡️os is how they build it, without rebuilding everything from scratch.

zaz⚡️os is a customizable all-in-one OS for running a company. Instead of stitching together point solutions, each company gets its own single-tenant workspace with 26+ ready apps (performance, feedback, hiring, time off, payments) and an AI Studio to adapt any of them, or build new ones, to how the company actually works.

one_liner.after: The custom all-in-one OS for each company.

long_description.before:
Bizmark is the operating system for companies that make, move, or sell physical goods.

Legacy ERPs force operators into templates that don’t reflect how the business runs. As a result, decisions that directly affect revenue, margins, and service levels are made from spreadsheets, with less information than the company has, often by whoever is closest, not whoever knows best.

Bizmark solves this by connecting to the systems, inboxes, spreadsheets, documents, and the knowledge that lives in people’s heads, then turning that context into optimized decisions and automated workflows. Bizmark adapts to how each company operates, not the other way around. And customers get a working product in weeks, not years.

Some of the most innovative American companies use Bizmark to transform their operations.
long_description.after: Bizmark deploys optimization methods at manufacturers, distributors and retailers. This traditionally took years of work; we do it in weeks through an agentic approach. Our first customers are seeing millions in value in weeks. We’re currently at $xxxk ARR after 8 weeks of work, and we’ve beaten SAP, Oracle, and Infor for those contracts. The founders are cousins Rodrigo Mosqueira and Oscar Aguilar, who’ve previously grown a supply chain business from 0 to $60M and implemented optimization methods at Intel, Amazon, and J&J.

one_liner.before: The OS for companies that make, move, or sell physical goods

long_description.before:
Moving Atoms is building robot models trained on internet scale video and designed to be micromanaged by LLMs.
Our first model, Atom 1, already tops the Physics IQ benchmark - this is stage 1 of the robot model we are building (a World Action Model).

Currently, robot models are trained end-to-end to recieve large scale tasks like "fold t-shirt". They were never designed to have an advanced LLM micromanaging them, telling them how to move and when (“reach(mug marked in frame)”, “grasp(marked mug at handle)”)

By training robot models that can be micro-managed, we allow robotics to use the orchestration and planning abilities of LLMs while having the physics, contact and timing be controlled by the robot model.
long_description.after:
Moving Atoms is frontier robotics lab. Our goal is to solve robotics, then solve abundance.

Our first model, Atom 1, pre-trained on the internets video, and fine tuned for physics, already tops the Physics IQ benchmark.

By using this model, we can significantly reduce the amount of robot data we need to collect to build our robot model (a world action model).

Our second core bet is to design our robot model to be micromanaged by LLMs, allow robotics to use the orchestration and planning abilities of LLMs while having the physics, contact and timing be controlled by the robot model (world action model).

one_liner.before: Robot Models designed to be controlled by LLMs

long_description.before:
World translation: not just changing voice and lips into a new language, but understanding the scene, the sound, and preserving the human.

🦋 Movies & TV, Micro-dramas, Live Broadcasts, Live Shopping, Corporate & Education, Ads, Creators & Podcasts, Platforms.  Day-and-date, in every territory.

Founders An Zhu Liu, Jibin Song, Mingi Kwon, and Xu Zheng lead a team of PhDs, professors, and researchers from the world's top universities who started the field of joint audio-visual human models and co-authored the current state of the art in real-time human animation. Since 2021: over 10,000 citations and 100+ papers at ICLR, NeurIPS, CVPR, ECCV, and more.

They started with video language translation, and they've already built one of the most accurate translators available today, the only one that works in real time. Everyone else scaffolds separate models and pre-processing; a world model just understands -- what the speaker means, from voice, person, and scene together. 

Vs ElevenLabs: they lose the laughter, the music, the ambiance -- 270% more background-sound error -- and ours sounds 27.8% more like you. Vs human translators: 100.3% of their quality -- scalable, real time. Published benchmarks: https://thefamiliarlab.com/benchmark

That means no recasting, no ADR, no M&E stems required -- it works from the final mix.

The $14B spent on dubbing every year flips to AI once it's good enough -- most of it movies and TV, the traditional dubbing heartland. Live multiplies it: a $32 billion market.

Familiar is a neolab building world models for accurate humans.
long_description.after:
Audio-visual translation infrastructure for all video, live and recorded -- the first and only that works in real time. World translation: not just changing voice and lips into a new language, but understanding the scene, the sound, and preserving the human.

🦋 Movies & TV, Micro-dramas, Live Broadcasts, Live Shopping, Corporate & Education, Ads, Creators & Podcasts, Platforms. Day-and-date, in every territory.

Founders An Zhu Liu, Jibin Song, Mingi Kwon, and Xu Zheng lead a team of PhDs, professors, and researchers from the world's top universities who started the field of joint audio-visual human models and co-authored the current state of the art in real-time human animation. Since 2021: over 10,000 citations and 100+ papers at ICLR, NeurIPS, CVPR, ECCV, and more.

Translation has to be a world model. A translator has to know who's speaking: where every sound in the dense polyphony originates. Laughter here, a short yell there, a voice from off-screen, someone on screen mouthing words before being interrupted. Everyone else scaffolds separate models and pre-processing; a world model simulates the scene. It's a spatio-temporal reasoner: predicting continuity across frames forces it to internalize 3D geometry, spatial reasoning, and permanence -- of objects, people, and the environment itself. The scene state survives the edit: when the shot pans or cuts away, someone off-screen still exists, still owns their voice, and is still there when the camera comes back. Multiple people, side views, off angles, fast motion -- the hard cases hold.

Vs ElevenLabs: they lose the laughter, the music, the ambiance -- 270% more background-sound error -- and ours sounds 27.8% more like you. That means no recasting, no ADR, no M&E stems required -- it works from the final mix.

Vs human translators: 100.3% of their quality -- scalable, real time. Published benchmarks: https://thefamiliarlab.com/benchmark

one_liner.before: Dubbing is Finally Good. Neolab for World Translation.
one_liner.after: Real-Time AI Dubbing. Neolab for World Translation.
